I have a complete, verified understanding. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextStep","claim":"nextStep returns the lowest-idx step whose status is not done/skipped/blocked and whose builds_on/blocks dependencies are all done/skipped; it returns null when no steps remain, {all_blocked:true} when every remaining step is blocked or dependency-waiting, or a full step object otherwise","evidence":"src/db.mjs:704-740"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store._unmetDeps","claim":"A step is dependency-gated only by outbound builds_on/blocks links to a to_step_id whose status is not done/skipped; plan-level links (to_plan_id only) are ignored and never gate a step","evidence":"src/db.mjs:696-701"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextStep","claim":"Blocked steps are skipped (not returned as workable) and reported in skipped_blocked_steps with reason 'blocked', while dependency-waiting steps get reason 'dependency' plus waiting_on_step_ids","evidence":"src/db.mjs:714-738"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.recordAttempt","claim":"A passing attempt sets the step to 'done' but a failing attempt sets it to 'failed' (not 'blocked'), so failed steps remain retryable and are still returned by nextStep","evidence":"src/db.mjs:672-675"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.readySteps","claim":"readySteps returns every pending non-blocked step whose deps are satisfied (the full concurrently-launchable frontier), using the same _depsSatisfied gate as nextStep so the two agree","evidence":"src/db.mjs:747-757"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.nextPlan","claim":"nextPlan skips plans with status done/abandoned/blocked and also skips a plan whose nextStep returns all_blocked, advancing to the next workable plan","evidence":"src/db.mjs:473-477"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/server.mjs#next_step tool","claim":"The next_step tool maps nextStep's three shapes to directives: null→complete (set plan done), all_blocked→set plan blocked and call next_plan, step→work it and call next_step again","evidence":"src/server.mjs:140-181"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#Store.getStep","claim":"getStep caps embedded attempts to the last 10 (oldest→newest) and includes attempts_total, links, notes, and file_refs in the full step payload nextStep hands out","evidence":"src/db.mjs:582-608"}]

VERDICT: pass — nextStep picks the lowest-idx non-done/skipped/blocked step with satisfied builds_on/blocks deps, skips blocked and dependency-waiting steps (reporting them), and returns null/{all_blocked}/step; blocked steps wait on a human and are skipped rather than wedging the plan.
